summary: Add reusable TypeScript hook helpers and a Claude Code adapter with command guards, incremental type checks, hook tests, workflows and review agents.
description: Build project-specific agent guards on shared Bun TypeScript hook helpers. For Claude Code, the adapter adds guarded commands, incremental typechecking, development commands and read-only review agents, with tests and a harness guide. The shared helpers can also support stack-owned Codex hooks. Each guard must be wired once and documented with its own regression cases.
seoDescription: Shared Bun TypeScript hook helpers plus a Claude Code development harness with command guards, typechecking, workflow commands and hook tests.

projectExamples.title: Generated client protection
projectExamples.description: Use the shared hook helpers to add a tested project guard for generated files. The stack or product must declare which paths it owns.

projectExamples.title: CLI development harness
projectExamples.description: Extend the TypeScript CLI's existing harness with project commands and tested guards. Keep paid operations and publishing outside automatic permissions.

plain.whatItIs: Adds tested guards and helper commands to Claude Code in a TypeScript project that uses Bun, a JavaScript runtime.
goodAt: Blocking certain commands and edits to generated files in Claude Code
Testing each guard against blocked actions and similar safe ones
Adding read-only helpers that review designs and code changes
notGoodAt: Sandboxing untrusted code; use a separate sandbox for that.
Projects that do not use Bun, or that use Cursor instead of Claude Code.

requests: catch TypeScript errors after Claude changes a file

give Claude commands for checking, testing and developing features
